title: LACToS: Local Anomaly Detection via Conditional Typicality of Superpixels
abstract: arXiv:2610.31538v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Local anomaly detection is the task of identifying spatially confined anomalous or out-of-distribution (OOD) regions within an otherwise in-distribution (ID) image. Most existing methods are designed for a specific context, with a strong focus on industrial defect detection, where they achieve excellent performance on well-established benchmarks. However, we observe that these methods can exhibit significant performance drops in other contexts, especially when the inlier distribution is multimodal. To account for this inlier complexity, we propose LACToS, a principled local OOD detection method based on statistical typicality and made tractable through two innovations: (i) grouping pixels into superpixels and (ii) using a computationally efficient proxy to estimate typicality. translated_title: LACToS：基于超像素条件典型性的局部异常检测
translated_abstract: 局部异常检测的任务是在整体上属于分布内（ID）的图像中识别空间上局限的异常或分布外（OOD）区域。大多数现有方法都是针对特定场景设计的，尤其聚焦于工业缺陷检测，并在成熟的基准数据集上取得了优异性能。然而，我们观察到这些方法在其他场景下可能出现显著的性能下降，尤其是当分布内数据的分布呈多模态时。为了应对这种分布内数据的复杂性，我们提出了LACToS，这是一种基于统计典型性的、有原则的局部OOD检测方法，并通过两项创新使其具备可计算性：(i) 将像素分组为超像素；(ii) 使用一种计算高效的代理方法来估计典型性。我们在医疗影像、人脸和X光安检三个不同的应用领域中评估了LACToS。LACToS的表现比先前方法更加稳健。
tldr: LACToS通过将像素分组为超像素并采用计算高效的代理来估计统计典型性，实现了一种在多模态分布内数据场景下依然稳健的局部分布外异常区域检测方法。
en_tdlr: LACToS is a principled local OOD detection method based on statistical typicality that remains robust across multimodal inlier distributions by grouping pixels into superpixels and estimating typicality through a computationally efficient proxy.
